intro: Deep in the jungle of Stranglethorn Vale, an attempt is made to preserve the young troll Yenniku. With the youth caught in a trance, a prepared soul gem is brought forth to capture his spirit.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yenniku stands stunned before you, his mind in another place...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You place the Soul Gem upon his forehead. He shudders as his soul is sucked in, leaving his body, a mindless husk, behind.
